name: @spyglass/desktop
description: Electron desktop shell for spyglass — wraps the local Bun server + web dashboard into a macOS-native app
author: spyglass

scripts.build:server-bins: SPYGLASS_BIN_ARCH=arm64 bun run build:server-bin && SPYGLASS_BIN_ARCH=x64 bun run build:server-bin
scripts.build:mac: bun run build:server-bins && electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.pack:mac: bun run build:server-bins && electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.yml --dir
